P1.name: p1_requirement_1
P1.check: Good case: public content contains only a title, section hierarchy, and minimal role placeholders

P1.name: p1_requirement_2
P1.check: Good case: private Suggestions use stable SG-NNN IDs and begin unchecked

P1.name: p1_requirement_3
P1.check: Bad case absent: the output does not contain developed body paragraphs, a recommendation, checked suggestions, or manufactured user feedback

P2.name: p2_requirement_1
P2.check: Good case: duplicate sections and equivalent suggestions are consolidated and the obsolete branch is removed

P2.name: p2_requirement_2
P2.check: Good case: the report identifies meaningful structural deletions

P2.name: p2_requirement_3
P2.check: Bad case absent: substantive user decisions are not silently discarded and removed material is not rewritten as filler

P3.name: p3_requirement_1
P3.check: Good case: feedback is classified before action and the planning-owned request updates research or structure

P3.name: p3_requirement_2
P3.check: Good case: the prose request becomes an unchecked FB-NNN thread with the original wording

P3.name: p3_requirement_3
P3.check: Bad case absent: mf-plan does not rewrite the opening paragraph, resolve the writing thread, or silently delete either request

W1.name: w1_requirement_1
W1.check: Good case: checked suggestions are treated as persistent accepted intent

W1.name: w1_requirement_2
W1.check: Good case: existing prose that already satisfies SG-001 is not inserted a second time

W1.name: w1_requirement_3
W1.check: Bad case absent: unchecked SG-002 is not developed and suggestion checkboxes are not reinterpreted as completion state

W2.name: w2_requirement_1
W2.check: Good case: the feedback remains anchored with the same FB-003 ID and immutable request

W2.name: w2_requirement_2
W2.check: Good case: a concrete resolution reply is appended before the item becomes checked

W2.name: w2_requirement_3
W2.check: Bad case absent: the item is not checked merely on acknowledgement and thread history is not deleted

W3.name: w3_requirement_1
W3.check: Good case: FB-004 changes from checked to unchecked and preserves its prior request and resolution

W3.name: w3_requirement_2
W3.check: Good case: a dated reopening reply records the new concern

W3.name: w3_requirement_3
W3.check: Bad case absent: a new ID does not replace FB-004, history is not overwritten, and unsupported author intent is not invented

W4.name: w4_requirement_1
W4.check: The complete FB-005 thread moves to the existing prompt Open Loop with the supplied reason and source anchor, preserving ordered history.

W4.name: w4_requirement_2
W4.check: The deferred request is not marked resolved; remaining evidence gaps are reported for human delivery judgment without a universal all-feedback-closed gate.

W4.name: w4_requirement_3
W4.check: No publication occurs because readiness review did not authorize it.

N1.name: n1_requirement_1
N1.check: The zero-output mind is inspected with the CLI, thinking records the unresolved comparison, and no output or recommendation is created.

N2.name: n2_requirement_1
N2.check: The actual resolver ambiguity is reported with exact candidate identities, and no files are changed.

N3.name: n3_requirement_1
N3.check: Only the selected design output is revised, repetition is removed, and the signature and sibling output bytes remain unchanged.

N3.name: n3_requirement_2
N3.check: The additional review is previewed and renamed through CLI, with original bytes and owner preserved, and index consistency is verified without repeated permission.

N4.name: n4_requirement_1
N4.check: Thinking records new fact/conflict, original judgment and affected section; only Evidence is revised and cites the supplied source without extrapolating long-term reliability.

N5.name: n5_requirement_1
N5.check: Repetition is removed, FB-006 stays open with immutable request/history and a concrete missing rollback-evidence condition.

N6.name: n6_requirement_1
N6.check: An actual failing CLI build is observed and accurately reported; no source repair, publication or success registration occurs.
